title: quercus faginea subsp. maroccana
intro: Quercus faginea subsp. maroccana, commonly known as Atlas Cork Oak, is a subspecies of oak tree native to the Atlas Mountains in North Africa. It is valued for its timber and is also used in traditional medicine due to its potential health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties. The therapeutic actions of Quercus faginea subsp. maroccana are attributed to its ability to soothe digestive issues, reduce fever, and alleviate respiratory problems. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
